name: LabeledCard
description: Card variant that pairs a tiny label above the body — used for compact stat or metadata blocks

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class for the root element

props.name: isFullWidth
props.description: Stretches the card to full container width

props.name: isFullHeight
props.description: Stretches the card to full container height

props.name: isScrollable
props.description: Enables vertical scroll on the card body

props.name: label
props.description: Header content shown above the card body

props.name: getNavigateOptions
props.type: (label: string) => Partial<{ href: string; target: string }>
props.description: Returns a link `href`/`target` for the label when provided

props.name: labelTooltip
props.description: Tooltip shown when hovering the label, e.g. to explain what a count includes
